newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Central Garden upgraded.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Central Garden upgraded.

text.p: -- Hambrecht & Quist analyst Hank Wilson said he upgraded Central Garden & Pet Co to strong buy from buy.
-- introduced a 1998 earnings estimate of $1.38 per share for the distributor of lawn, garden and pet supply products.

-- Wilson said he conducted a detailed telephone survey of retailers across the country over the last several days, and found the spring garden season appears off to an earlier and stronger start than expected, and better than last year.

-- believes the Federal Trade Commission should complete its public commentary period on Central's proposed acquisition of Sandoz AG's SANZ.S flea and tick business by mid-March, and should issue formal approval by mid-April.
-- He said the acquisition could add $0.03 to $0.05 per share to 1997 earnings. He estimated 1997 earnings at $1.08 per share.
